run_generate_jigsaw_permutations: run the script to generate N permutations for M patches using hamming distance selection
run_max_avg_permutations: run the script with max_avg method to select permutations maximizing average hamming distance
run_max_min_permutations: run the script with max_min method to select permutations maximizing minimum hamming distance
generate_permutations_custom_patches: generate permutations for a custom number of patches using the --M argument
save_permutations_to_npy: save selected permutations as a numpy .npy file to the specified output directory
